summary: End-to-end backend + frontend testing of HRIS PT Mitra Karya Sarana. All critical flows PASS: auth for 3 users; per-user Portal PIN; Gaji PIN gate + reset flow; access segregation (herliana=all, heri=non-gaji only, backend returns 403 for gaji endpoints); Excel import parses 5 SLIP GAJI sheets and Take Home for Wawan = 8,138,000 (matches PEMBULATAN); PDF endpoint returns valid application/pdf; email settings save works (Gmail App Password intentionally not configured — blast not tested per instructions); super admin admin panel with access matrix (30 checkboxes = 5 menus x 6 columns incl. all); heri visiting /admin sees 'Khusus Super Admin' access-denied card.

minor.issue: pytest.ini forces `-n 2 --dist loadscope`, but module-scoped fixtures with shared HTTP/DB state (portal PIN set) can cause race between workers. Suite must be run with `-n 0` for deterministic pass. Consider marking suite serial or making fixtures self-recovering.

critical_code_review_comments: deps.py: SUPER_ADMIN_USERNAME default is 'susanto' (legacy). Fine since .env overrides to 'superadmin', but the default is misleading for this app.

server.py CORS uses `allow_origin_regex='.*'` with allow_credentials=True. This is permissive but functionally required for cross-origin cookies in the preview. Consider tightening to preview + prod domains for production.

hrd.py request_gaji_pin_reset is guarded by require_hrd (portal PIN required). This means a user who has forgotten Gaji PIN but still has a valid Portal PIN can request reset — heri (no gaji access) could also spam requests. Consider restricting to gaji-menu users only or rate-limiting.
hrd.py apply_gaji_pin_reset resolves ALL pending requests (update_many). Fine functionally, but may cause confusion if multiple users have distinct pending reasons.

Frontend LoginPage does not clear existing session before login submit — navigating to /login while a valid access_token cookie exists silently redirects to home. Not a bug but complicates automated logout flows.
